label: Theory of Change Builder
description: Build a rigorous Theory of Change (ToC) narrative mapping inputs → activities → outputs → outcomes → impact, with causal assumptions, evidence base, and pathway validation for NGO programmes.

claudeKnowledge.description: Theory of Change methodology, impact evaluation, programme design

guidedInputs.label: Programme description
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. A 3-year girls' education programme in rural Kenya combining teacher training, school feeding, and community engagement to improve secondary school completion rates.

guidedInputs.label: Intended long-term impact
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Improved life outcomes and economic participation for adolescent girls in the target counties.

options.label: Mid-term — revisiting the ToC against evidence

guidedInputs.label: Known evidence or prior results
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Pilot in 2 districts showed 18% attendance improvement; systematic reviews support school feeding for enrolment but evidence on completion is mixed.

exampleInput: Build a Theory of Change for a 3-year programme in northern Ghana that aims to raise secondary-school completion for adolescent girls in two districts. Components: bursaries covering fees and materials for 2,400 girls, training for 180 teachers on gender-responsive pedagogy, community dialogue sessions with parents and traditional leaders, and a mentorship scheme pairing girls with local female professionals. Funded by FCDO; the proposal needs both a ToC narrative and a log-frame-compatible results chain. A 2023 pilot in one district lifted attendance by 14%, but completion data is not yet available. Be explicit about causal assumptions and where the evidence is weak.

exampleValues.programme_description: 3-year girls' secondary-education programme in two districts of northern Ghana: bursaries (fees + materials) for 2,400 girls, gender-responsive pedagogy training for 180 teachers, community dialogues with parents and traditional leaders, and a mentorship scheme pairing girls with local female professionals.
exampleValues.intended_impact: Adolescent girls in the target districts complete secondary education and progress to further study or decent work, improving lifetime earnings and reducing early marriage.
exampleValues.known_evidence: 2023 single-district pilot: +14% attendance; completion impact not yet measured. Systematic reviews support cost-reduction interventions (bursaries) for enrolment; evidence that teacher training alone shifts completion is mixed; mentorship evidence is promising but thin in West African contexts.
